title: STOINLY.EXE
tagline: Rip packs, fight THE 215, survive PARENTS' DIVORCE. The odds were never 1 in 6.

actions.label: Sound on or off (this game only)

mouse: Left click a card to play it. With two or more enemies, click the card, then the enemy.
Left click map rooms, rewards, shop items and buttons to choose them.
Right click: cancel the selected card. Right click a snack during a run to drop it.
Click the draw, discard or exhaust pile to see what is in it.
Hover over cards, statuses, relics and numbers to read their rules.

howToPlay.title: Goal
howToPlay.body: Climb the 16 floors of Act 1 and beat PARENTS' DIVORCE on floor 16. Your HP carries from fight to fight; at 0 HP the run is over. A run in progress is not saved: leaving it ends it.

howToPlay.title: Fights
howToPlay.body: Each turn you get 3 Energy and draw 5 cards (some cards and relics change this). A card's cost is the number in its top-left corner. Each enemy shows its next move above it. Block absorbs damage and is removed at the start of your next turn. Press END TURN (E) when you are done and the enemies act.

howToPlay.title: The map
howToPlay.body: Each floor you pick one room connected to the last: WRESTLING MEET (a fight), THE SWAMP (an elite fight), OPEN CRIB (usually a forum-thread event), REHAB (heal 28 HP or grade a card), WHITE HEN (the shop) and ROULAIN'S ROOM (take a relic or trade cards). Floor 1 is always a WRESTLING MEET, floor 9 is ROULAIN'S ROOM, floor 15 is REHAB and floor 16 is the boss.

howToPlay.title: Rewards and packs
howToPlay.body: After a fight you get FREE MONEY and a pack to rip: keep one card or skip it. Regular fights sometimes add a snack; elites add a relic and their pack has at least one RARE or better.

howToPlay.title: FREE MONEY
howToPlay.body: FREE MONEY is capped at 250. A payment that would take you over the cap is DELETED FOR FREE in full, and the total deleted is the run's score. The mail brings 5 FREE MONEY each time you leave a room (10 with the POSTAGE relic).

howToPlay.title: Stars
howToPlay.body: Each run earns up to 3 stars: reach floor 9; beat PARENTS' DIVORCE; beat it with at least half your max HP. Stars add up and are never spent. They unlock card backs and board themes, which change nothing but the look. Practice fights do not earn stars.

howToPlay.title: Daily run
howToPlay.body: DAILY RUN gives everyone the same map, packs and fights for the day, seeded from your computer's local date. Your best daily result (most stars, then highest floor, then most DELETED FOR FREE) is kept separately. You can play it as often as you like.

howToPlay.title: Streak and daily chest
howToPlay.body: Starting a run on consecutive local days builds your day streak; miss a day and it goes back to 0. Once per local day the title screen's chest opens for free: a chest-only card back or board theme, or 1 to 3 stars.

howToPlay.title: Practice
howToPlay.body: The list on the title screen is PRACTICE: one fight with the starting deck, 90 HP and no relics. It does not count toward stars, the streak or anything else.

howToPlay.title: Collection and unlocks
howToPlay.body: COLLECTION shows which of the 33 SERIES 1 cards you have pulled; every card a pack shows counts. UNLOCKS lists the card backs and board themes, with NEW! on ones you have not looked at yet. Both are kept in this browser.
